generation.scope: The rank-five crossed-bracket chart with diagonal Cartan and all six nonzero off-diagonal skew entries rigidifies to C(t), with t-squared modulo inversion as projective bracket parameter. All marked lifts and all their AS and indexed classes are determined: typically two period-two W and two period-one central quantum deformations; on the two nonregular W parameters only the central pair survives, at t-squared=-1 all sheets coincide, and at the diagonal endpoint only W(1) is regular. Root of unity central quotients and all allowed special values are included.
